prompt: Which test verifies that a method throws IllegalArgumentException for negative input?
choices: @Test void test() { try { calculator.sqrt(-1); } catch (Exception e) { assertTrue(true); } }
explanation: assertThrows(ExType.class, executable) verifies the executable throws exactly that exception type. It also returns the exception for further inspection. Option A: if no exception is thrown, test passes silently. Option B: fragile — passes even if no exception is thrown.
